segments.source: Two hunters camping in the woods were preparing supper one night when a Katydid began singing near them.
One of them said sneeringly, “ Kû!
It sings and don’t know that it will die before the season ends.”
The Katydid answered: “ Kû! niwĭ (onomatope); O, so you say; but you need not boast.
You will die before to-morrow night.”
The next day they were surprised by the enemy and the hunter who had sneered at the Katydid was killed.
